summary: Iteration 3 covers the new 5-step tag-based onboarding + PrefsIn cuisines/skill_level backend widening. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass (100%) — the 28 previously-passing regression tests are green (auth, PATCH /auth/me, recipes, likes/saves/history, subscription, AI generate + save-generated with numeric coercion, AI ask, AI scale, meal-plan CRUD with 402 gating) AND 3 new tests specifically for onboarding: (1) PUT /me/preferences with cuisines=['Italian','Thai'] + skill_level='intermediate' persists correctly and is echoed on GET /auth/me, (2) skip-all payload (only onboarded=true) defaults to empty arrays and skill_level=None, (3) freshly-registered users are NOT onboarded (preferences.onboarded is falsy) so the frontend index.tsx correctly routes them to /onboarding. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): registered TWO fresh accounts on the deployed URL. Happy path: after Register the app redirected to /onboarding, all 5 step headers rendered ('How do you like to eat?', 'Which cuisines make you happy?', 'What do you love cooking with?', 'How would you describe your cooking?', 'Anything you'd rather not see?'). Step 1 shows Skip (onb-skip-step) bottom-left; steps 2-5 show Back (onb-back). 'Skip all' (onb-skip-all) pill is visible on every step. Chip toggle verified — tapping same chip repeatedly toggles selection. Skill cards (beginner/intermediate/advanced) also toggle. After completing with diet=Vegetarian, cuisines=[Italian,Thai], faves=[Pasta], skill=intermediate, dislikes='peanuts, cilantro' the app landed on /home. Fetching /api/auth/me via in-page fetch confirmed the user document has preferences.diet=['Vegetarian'], cuisines=['Italian','Thai'], liked_ingredients=['Pasta'], disliked=['peanuts','cilantro'], skill_level='intermediate', onboarded=true. Reload → /home (bypasses /onboarding). Skip-all path with a second fresh account also landed on /home and persisted onboarded=true with all empty arrays and skill_level=None. Test users were deleted after each run to keep the DB clean.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx persist() correctly spreads payload AFTER the base fields so skipAll's explicit empty arrays/undefined win over any prior state — good.
skill_level is sent as `skill || undefined` which lets the backend's Optional[str]=None default kick in — good.
PrefsIn now has cuisines: List[str]=[] and skill_level: Optional[str]=None; PUT /me/preferences returns the updated user doc with these fields visible under preferences — good.
index.tsx correctly routes to /onboarding when !user.preferences?.onboarded — verified on fresh registrations.

Note: the seed() default preferences dict in server.py (line 216, 711) still only initialises {diet, liked_ingredients, disliked} — cuisines/skill_level keys are absent until first PUT. This is fine because Python .get() returns None and the client uses optional chaining, but for consistency you may want to seed cuisines=[] and skill_level=None too. Not a bug.
server.py is ~750 lines — soft-cap comment from prior iterations still applies; consider splitting when it grows further.
No expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage introduced. No SafeAreaView deprecation issues in onboarding.tsx (uses react-native-safe-area-context useSafeAreaInsets — correct).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested onboarding flows (5-step happy path + persistence + reload-bypass + skip-all)
